source.title: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
source.text: Bytedance and several US universities introduce Axion 1.0, an AI agent that rivals top commercial models from OpenAI and Anthropic on benchmarks after just three training phases. The researchers attribute the gains to carefully curated training data rather than ever more training steps. The model, data, and code are freely available. The article Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model appeared first on The Decoder .

The model, named Axion 1.0, rivals top commercial AI from OpenAI and Anthropic on benchmarks. Researchers attribute the performance to carefully curated training data rather than endless training steps.

The model, data, and code are freely available.

Will curated data quality make massive training runs obsolete?
